title: Hesitation-and-Go Series
description: Players practise the hesitation move — a change of pace without changing hands — to set up a burst past an imaginary defender.

content.objective: Sell a change of pace convincingly enough to beat a defender off the dribble.
content.setup: Players space out around the key, each with a ball, facing the basket.
instructions: Dribble forward at a medium pace for two dribbles.
Rise up slightly as if preparing to shoot, hesitating for a half-second.
Explode forward low and fast for three hard dribbles.
Finish the move with a layup or a pull-up, then reset and repeat.
coachingPoints: Change the ball's rhythm, not just the body's.
Keep the shoulders level during the hesitation — don't lean back.
Explode on the first step after the hesitation, not the second.
commonMistakes: Standing all the way up during the hesitation.
Taking the same speed in and out of the move.
Speeding up until control breaks down, instead of building speed gradually.
content.safety: Leave room ahead for a full-speed burst without running into another group.
variations: Finish with a pull-up jump shot instead of a drive to the rim.
